import { KPIRing, KPIValue } from '@/registry/dashboardblocks/kpi' import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card' interface ProgressKPI3Props { className?: string current?: number goal?: number title?: string unit?: string } export const ProgressKPI3 = ({ className = '', current = 7500, goal = 10000, title = 'Monthly Goal', unit = 'sales', }: ProgressKPI3Props) => { const percentage = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (current / goal) * 100)) return (
{title}
{current.toLocaleString()} of {goal.toLocaleString()} {unit}
{Math.round(percentage)}%
) }
